## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Validation

List the checks you ran and their results.

## Merge checklist

- [ ] The change is generic and reusable.
- [ ] Relevant backend and frontend checks pass.
- [ ] Infrastructure changes were validated where applicable.
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, or local environment files are included.
- [ ] Public APIs and generated-project behavior remain compatible.
- [ ] Documentation is updated for user-visible changes.
